name: design-partner
description: Audit, build, and refine interfaces with evidence-based findings and accessibility guidance.

interface.longDescription:
Turn a rough interface into a clearer, more usable product. Design Partner helps you review a page, build a new screen, or improve an existing flow directly in your project.

Start with a focused critique of a landing page, dashboard, form, or settings flow. Get prioritized findings that explain what is wrong, where it happens, why it affects users, and what to change. Ask for a report only, or follow up with implementation.

Improve typography, spacing, color, responsive layouts, and interaction states. Repair keyboard navigation, form labels, focus behavior, and other accessibility barriers. Refine the current visual direction or explore a redesign while preserving the content and behavior you want to keep.

Design Partner works with your existing framework, components, and design tokens. It guides the agent to check its changes with the tools available and distinguish verified results from remaining gaps.

Try: “Review my billing page without changing files,” “Fix the signup flow for keyboard users,” or “Polish this dashboard without changing its brand.”

For implementation, provide access to your project files. Browser checks require browser tools in your agent environment. No separate Design Partner account or service is needed.
defaultPrompt: Review my billing page and prioritize improvements. Do not change files yet.
Fix keyboard navigation, labels, and focus in my signup flow.
Polish this dashboard's typography and spacing while preserving its brand and behavior.
